summary: Neo-Nazi broadcaster Kevin Strom, William Pierce's right hand at the National Alliance's West Virginia compound, coined a quote now misattributed to Voltaire and was later imprisoned in Virginia for possessing child sexual abuse material.

evidence.note: Opens as Molly Conger's Weird Little Guys, a Cool Zone Media show, not a BtB episode
1993 National Alliance radio broadcast is the real source of the quote
Quote spread as a meme by politicians and Elon Musk, 2015-2023
Pierce founds National Alliance in 1974 and starts The Turner Diaries in 1975
Life on the compound with first wife: media bans, hidden gun tubes, propaganda mailing
Strom destroys records after the Oklahoma City bombing tied to the Alliance
Strom berates his wife and blocks her depression treatment; custody battle follows
2005 failed coup inside National Alliance and founding of National Vanguard splinter
Strom fixates on a nine-year-old classmate of his stepdaughter
FBI memo on Alliance fracturing and JTTF role in the search
Guilty plea, release in 2008, return to the Alliance by 2013
Off supervision and the sex offender registry as of 2023, still broadcasting

notes: Format crossover: a Weird Little Guys episode (Molly Conger) republished in the BtB feed. Roles and time filled anyway since it is a biography. Covered span starts at the 1974 Alliance founding; Strom's early-1970s Birch Society start is about a minute. Virginia and West Virginia both central, so no subdivision. Transcript spells Gliebe as Glebe. Birth year 1956 from general knowledge.
